steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The twelve Olympian gods lived on Mount Olympus and ruled different aspects of the world | Key Fact: Zeus was king of the gods, god of the sky, thunder and justice; his symbols are the thunderbolt and eagle | Key Fact: Hera was queen of the gods, goddess of marriage and childbirth; she was famously jealous of Zeus's affairs | Key Fact: Poseidon was god of the sea, earthquakes and horses; his symbol is the trident
